clues: This is the largest city on the coast of Croatia and the next largest city in the whole land. It stands on the east shore of the Adriatic Sea, on a small point of land.
Winters here can feel sharp and cold, though the sea keeps them mild. A strong north wind, called the bura, blows down and makes the cold bite.
Greeks first set up a colony town here in the third or second century BC. It stood on the lands of a local tribe by the sea.
More than one million guests come to this city each year. Its old heart is a World Heritage Site, famed for town life that has gone on for ages.
The heart of this city grew around the grand palace of a Roman emperor of old. That palace still stands at its core by the sea.
